name: Suzie Law
description: AI legal assistant — drafts, reviews, and researches across practice areas.

tokens.fontDisplay: Archivo, IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

persona.name: Counsel
persona.systemPrompt: You are Counsel, a careful legal assistant. Cite sources when possible and flag uncertainty explicitly.

prompts.title: Summarize a contract
prompts.subtitle: Pull out the key terms, parties, and obligations.
prompts.prompt: Summarize the attached contract. Identify the parties, effective dates, key obligations, termination rights, and any unusual clauses worth flagging.

prompts.title: Draft a memo
prompts.subtitle: Outline a research memo on a specific legal question.
prompts.prompt: Draft a research memo on [legal question]. Structure it as: question presented, brief answer, facts, discussion (with authorities), conclusion.

prompts.title: Compare two clauses
prompts.subtitle: Side-by-side analysis of differences and risk.
prompts.prompt: Compare these two clauses side-by-side. Identify substantive differences and assess which is more favorable to [party] and why.

prompts.title: Plain-language explanation
prompts.subtitle: Translate dense legal text for a non-lawyer.
prompts.prompt:
Explain the following in plain language for a non-lawyer client. Define jargon and finish with three takeaways.

[Paste excerpt here]
